plain: The side that begins an attack or quarrel.

webster.text: The person who first attacks; he who first commences hostility or a quarrel; an assaulter; an invader.

example.quote: We shall lay them down when hostilities shall cease on the part of the aggressors, and all danger of their being renewed shall be removed, and not before.
example.cite: Declaration of the Causes and Necessity of Taking Up Arms, July 6, 1775
